title: b7z9.35(c): Python gateway — mount tunnel_auth resource + egress wiring
description: Child of b7z9.35. python/src/lichen/gateway/tunnel_auth.py is used by tests only (python/tests/gateway/test_tunnel_auth.py, 14 tests). Mount the /.well-known/tunnel-auth resource in the Python gateway CoAP assembly and wire the egress forwarding check (route_hash gate) into the python gateway forwarding path.
